title: Volume 2 Chapter 1: To You Whom I Can Reach with My Hand, But Whose Voice Cannot Reach Me 2
content: That's quite the education,
" I said, scratching my head and letting out a sigh.
So the guild master is bald, huh?
Alright, I get it.
I'll go.
I just need to collect it, right?
" Shara shouted,
"You refused when I asked!
" If you want to make a request to an adventurer, you can use the principles upheld by the Adventurer Guild as a shield.
In other words,
"Fight on behalf of those who lack the power to fight.
" The trick is to not directly use that principle as a shield.
If you do, everyone will just smirk and say,
"Oh, right, that's the Adventurer Guild's principle,
" and that would be the end of it.
A light provocation is all that's needed.
They'll fold immediately.
Why!
You flat-out refused when I said it!
That's terrible!
Shin-san, that's terrible!
" Shara shouted, and I raised my right hand in a gesture of exasperation, hiding behind Erika.
Look!
We're going now!
Right away!
" I walked through the streets, responding casually to Shara's frantic pushes.
The Adventurer Guild is located on the south side of the city, while the Demon Realm lies to the north, which is quite a hassle.
If it were a request or something like
"Let's defeat a monster!
" it wouldn't be a bother, but the thought of retrieving the magic stones we left behind made me feel lazy.
It's too much trouble.
Even just walking to the entrance of the barrier on the Demon Realm side is a hassle.
Other adventurers probably feel the same way about the long trek from the Adventurer Guild to the Demon Realm.
To alleviate that somewhat, the city of Hekatai has, on the surface, a dedicated street for adventurers to use.
It makes it a bit easier to avoid the congestion in the city.
I have a question,
" Erika, who had been curiously looking at an illegal food stall selling portable meals for adventurers, called out as I was lost in thought about how troublesome it all was.
I turned my head.
Erika was right next to me.
My heart raced.
If we go now, do you think the magic stones are still there?
"I wonder,
" I replied.
Since they were designated targets for subjugation, their locations were somewhat known.
So, it seemed more likely that they had already been collected.
At the very least, if it were in Faltarl, someone would have collected them long ago.
If someone tried to steal another person's magic stones, it would lead to an immediate fight.
This time, however, we had declared that we, the ones who defeated them, had left them behind.
Those searching for them wouldn't hold back.
To be honest, I think the chances of it being a wasted trip are higher,
" I said, and Erika tilted her head in confusion.
Her eyes sparkled with happiness, far too much happiness.
This was probably her way of asking,
"If that's the case, then why?
"But well, that's the way of adventurers,
" I said.
The way of adventurers?
" I wondered if Erika, being a daughter of a high noble family, would understand.
I searched for the right words.
Well, we adventurers are fundamentally responsible for ourselves.
" For some reason, Erika nodded happily.
That seems right, indeed.
" It was as if she had been praised for a precious treasure, and she smiled proudly.
And, well, to put it bluntly, being an adventurer is basically a profession where if you're not strong enough, you just die on your own.
" To put it plainly, that's exactly what it is.
The way of adventurers is essentially akin to a policy of abandonment.
Nobles claim they grant us the
"right to fight,
" but from the adventurer's perspective, they are merely cleaning up after the nobles who can't handle monster extermination.
Moreover, the Adventurer Guild even prohibits teaching adventurers combat skills systematically.
What are the nobles thinking?
I’m a noble too, though.
Because of this, adventurers tend to have a strong sense of mutual aid.
The system where rookie adventurers become apprentices to veteran adventurers arose spontaneously.
It's about getting along with those who have been cast aside.
Well, since most of them are fools who think they can make a living through violence, there are only fools around.
And among those fools, there’s one more thing they cherish: the principles of the Adventurer Guild.
Fight on behalf of those who lack the power to fight.
" This simple principle is something that, in times of peace, even adventurers and the Adventurer Guild would scoff at, but adventurers—at least the decent ones—do not betray it.
Those who couldn’t find a place in villages or towns have made up their minds to survive through violence, laughing at such principles while acknowledging their existence.
Yet, the principle upheld by the Adventurer Guild is something they cannot compromise on.
I explained the ecology of adventurers to Erika, which could also be called their way of life.
I've heard that adventurers who lack skill are injuring themselves, and as a result, the townspeople are suffering too,
" I said, counting the situations on my fingers and shrugging my shoulders.
I couldn't help but feel,
"Why is it me?
"Turning a blind eye to this isn't really the way of adventurers,
" I added after a moment of thought, using a more casual phrasing.
It's pretty lame, right?
Those adventurers.
" It's pretty lame, and Erika, who would never say such words if she were a normal noble daughter, murmured in admiration.
Watching this rare side of Erika, I thought to myself.
To be honest, I wondered what the veteran adventurers of Hekatai were doing.
We're rank one adventurers, after all.
Why do we, rank one adventurers, have to clean up after these fools?
I mean, they should just hurry up and collect the magic stones.
What are they dragging their feet for?
Got it?
" Erika murmured.
I wondered if Erika, being a noble daughter, couldn't understand.
She gently placed her hand on her well-shaped chin and nodded seriously.
Perhaps she was so confused that she wore a serious expression.
But still, Erika's serious face was beautiful.
The way of the free people...
It's a beautiful thing, isn't it?
"Huh?
"What’s with that face?
"I was just hoping you wouldn't be disillusioned.
" Erika tilted her head at my words.
So cute.
I like it.
Gyaa!
Waa!
Guweee!

" As we arrived near the area where we fought the Forest Dragon in the Demon Realm, the screams and shouts of the townspeople flowed out in a torrent, likely the number they would hear over several years.
I knew it, I knew it all too well.
I felt a headache coming on from the sheer absurdity of human foolishness being displayed so easily.
Damn it!
Send more people over here!
We can't hold the front line!
"What is the magic stone recovery team doing?!
"How should I know!
Just hold the line!
If we survive and succeed in the recovery, we win!
" The place where we fought the massive Forest Dragon had turned into a battlefield for adventurers.
I could roughly guess what had happened by seeing the adventurers forming makeshift parties to fight together.
Monsters, in simple terms, are creatures that attack with hostility as soon as they see a person.
Monsters don't follow the logic of wolves or bears.
With a few exceptions, monsters will attack as soon as they see a human.
The Demon Realm is a land where such monsters swarm in large numbers.
So, what happens if you throw a bunch of adventurers who usually only work in the city into such a place?
The answer was right in front of me.
The monsters, lured by the large number of humans, attacked, and those monsters attracted even more monsters.
Before they could be dealt with, the number of monsters swelled, creating a mountain of injured people that could overwhelm the church.
Adventurers with a certain level of skill filled in for those who dropped out due to injuries.
Ultimately, they had to work together to hold the line, and it naturally led to a division into defense teams and magic stone recovery teams, with the rewards being split among them.
Why do you all only show your cleverness and skill in such situations?
I wish you'd apply that cleverness and skill elsewhere.
What a horrible sight,
" Shara murmured, sounding more disheartened than I had imagined.
Please stop, I want to quit being an adventurer.
" Adventurers digging into the ground with bloodshot eyes, and others forming makeshift parties to fight against the swarm of monsters.
Am I being seen as one of them?
I was too scared to look back at Erika's face.
An adventurer was being beaten by a Great Demon, striking back with a half-broken sword.
It's a great spirit, but knowing it's driven by greed makes it hard to admire.
That's amazing,
" I involuntarily turned around at Erika's completely opposite reaction.
To be so honest about what you desire...
That's wonderful.
" Erika said, her eyes sparkling.
Wow, it's amazing how words can change perception; suddenly, adventurers seemed wonderful when Erika said so.
Yeah, I guess I'm starting to feel that way too.
"Please come back to your senses, Shin-san.
" Shara said,
"What are you talking about?
"Erika, please come back to your senses too.
No matter how you look at it, that's...
" Shara pointed to an adventurer being eaten headfirst by a giant frog monster.
A bunch of idiots.
A bunch of idiots from start to finish.
Where's the wonderful element in that?
" She's relentless.
Well, from Shara's perspective, it's understandable she'd want to say that since these idiots are causing the church to be overwhelmed since morning.
The church and adventurers have a good relationship due to their similar principles, but it seems they've crossed a line that shouldn't be crossed.
As I calmed down after Shara's words, I thought,
"Yeah, that makes sense,
" when suddenly an adventurer was thrown in front of me by a monster.
Rewards... split... designated subjugation target's magic stones...
" The adventurer who rolled over murmured with vacant eyes as he stood up.
Yeah, this is bad, really bad.
I accidentally made eye contact with the adventurer.
Hey, what are you all doing just standing there?
If you can fight, help out!
The rewards will be split!
" It seems we can't just collect the magic stones on our own and resolve the situation.
If we were to step in and collect the magic stones, we'd earn a lot of resentment from the other adventurers.
Since we were the ones who defeated the Forest Dragon, there wouldn't be any issues with us taking the magic stones, but... it's more about the vibe.
I can tolerate being told I can't read the air, but being told I have a bad vibe is frustrating.
There's hardly anyone as enthusiastic as I am!
If you're not going to fight, then get out of here!
"Hey, hey, who do you think I am?
" I reflexively shot back, provoked.
I don't know... wait, I've seen you somewhere.
" The adventurer looked off into the distance, trying to recall.
I'm Shin Longdagger, the husband of Erika Longdagger!
" I declared as I charged into the nearby crumbling front line.
For now, I should help the guy being eaten headfirst by the frog.
Eh!?
Is that the flow?
Shin-san, you're too easy to provoke!
"I see, so that's the flow.
A self-introduction, huh?
" Erika and Shara were saying something behind me, but that can wait.
Longdagger is here!
Collect the magic stones before they're stolen!
" The adventurer from earlier shouted in a panic.
I am Erika Longdagger, the wife of Shin Longdagger!
Please remember me!
" Erika declared proudly.
Me too!?
Am I included!?
Shara Ransura!
Um!
Seventeen years old!
" Shara shouted a simple self-introduction.

As I punched the frog's belly to rescue the adventurer, I felt anger at the thought of them stealing my magic stones, and I wore a creepy smile at Erika declaring herself my wife, while being shocked that Shara was older than me.
It was pure chaos.
But well, yeah.
It was very much like an adventurer.
Hey!
You lot!
Get your act together!
We're pushing forward!
" Ignoring the adventurers who looked at me as if to say,
"Who are you?
" I shouted.
I'm one of the idiots too.
In a chaotic battle, anything can happen.
Especially since Erika had learned knightly swordsmanship at the academy, but she probably hadn't trained to fight alongside many adventurers against a swarm of monsters.
I didn't worry too much about Shara, thinking she would manage somehow, but I was concerned about Erika.
It turned out to be an unnecessary worry.
Since it was a chaotic battle, perhaps to avoid getting caught up in it, Erika held back on using magic and mainly fought with her sword.
The surrounding adventurers were dumbfounded, saying,
"What the heck is that?
That tough monster was cut in half with one blow!
"It's so fast I can barely see it!
And you, there's no way you're actually seeing it, right?!
"Whoa!
The ogre just got sent flying!
" I couldn't stop grinning at the astonished reactions of the adventurers.
Isn't it great!?
She's my wife!
" I couldn't help but boast loudly.
As I swung around a giant horned rabbit-like monster with my left hand, other adventurers looked at me strangely.
What?
Are you jealous?
Of course you are!
Are you jealous!?
She's the best wife in the world!
" I smashed the head of a humanoid pig-like monster charging at me and kicked it away before it could turn into magic stones.
If it turned into magic stone debris at my feet, I'd be in danger of tripping.
My husband too...
" One of the adventurers muttered some mysterious words upon seeing that.
What does that mean?
I almost tilted my head in confusion while shouting out Erika's wonderful points when Erika rushed towards me with great speed.
For some reason, her face was red.
Shin, um, I understand why you're shouting so loudly.
But, um, I think that's enough.
" For a moment, I didn't understand what Erika was saying.
I was just happy to shout that I was Erika's husband...
I see, Erika must have thought I was doing this to impress the adventurers that we were a couple.
Earlier, she had also said she was Shin Longdagger's wife, so she probably thought the same about me.
Too bad!
I just wanted to brag.
But I understood that if I said that honestly, it would be seen as creepy.
I replied to Erika,
"Yeah, I guess so.
"I wanted to brag a little more.
" That slipped out as my true feelings.
That's enough!
Shin, listen!
It's enough!
" Erika said firmly, and I felt a little down inside.
With Erika by my side, the monsters that appeared in the first layer of the Demon Realm, known as the shallow layer, posed no threat.
As the rate of decrease in monsters surpassed the rate of increase, the other adventurers began to feel more relaxed.
It could be said that those who couldn't hold the front line had already dropped out.
Thanks...
Longdagger,
" a voice came to me, sounding like someone who couldn't swallow a bitter pill.
Who is this?
I'm the bumbling adventurer you rolled over at the guild the other day.
" The man introduced himself, seeing the confusion on my face.
Ah!
The fan of the Longdagger with the beard!
" I remembered.
He was the adventurer who had approached us when Erika and I registered as adventurers at the Hekatai Adventurer Guild.
Apparently, he thought I was a fake claiming to be the muscular Longdagger who suited a beard.
Sorry about that, so please let that go.
" The man raised both hands with an embarrassed expression, and I waved one hand to tell him not to worry about it.
I wasn't worried about it from the start, but what's up?
" Erika sliced through three shield boars in one stroke and then unleashed magic on a dangerous monster mixed in, causing a flashy explosion.
Watching Erika fight freely was cool.
She's wonderful, I like her.
As I asked, the man looked exasperated.
Your wife... no, it's fine.
Honestly, you saved us.
It was starting to look bad.
If it had continued like that, there might have been casualties.
" I couldn't help but stare at the man in surprise at his unexpected words.
So you were the one who organized the adventurers?
" I see, that’s why he seemed capable enough to be in a place like this.
He must have been observing the whole situation.
By the way, I was trying to use the excuse that I was going to help out while watching the whole situation, but really, I just wanted to see Erika.
They were all 'lacking' in skill,
" he said, shrugging his shoulders, looking very much like an adventurer.
What a surprise, a man who openly admits to organizing the scene is kind of cool.
Compared to that, here I am, complaining about how digging out magic stones buried in the ground is a hassle...
This is pathetic, so pathetic and uncool.
As I frowned at my own lameness, the man tilted his head.
I shook my head in response.
It's just that I suddenly felt pathetic for wanting to leave the buried magic stones alone, knowing the situation, so don't mind me.
"Leaving them alone?
Those are designated subjugation target magic stones, you know?
" He looked at me as if questioning my sanity.
Huh?
No, but they're buried in the ground, right?
" Is he suggesting I make Erika dig?
Is he out of his mind?
Why am I being looked at like I'm the one who's lost my mind?
" The man grumbled, and after a moment of questioning each other's sanity, I shrugged my shoulders and changed the subject.
It's fine, anyway, thanks, 'Longdagger.'
" I waved my hand at the man's words.
